# Executor configuration

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-config-reference.py from Terrakube origin/main. Do not edit by hand. -->

Environment variables of the Terrakube **Executor**. See [Configuration Reference](README.md) for how to set them. An empty default means the variable has no default: either it is optional or it must be provided.

### Terraform CLI Settings

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TerrakubeEnableColorOutput` | `true` | Sets `io.terrakube.terraform.flags.enableColor`. |
| `CustomTerraformReleasesUrl` |  | Sets `io.terrakube.terraform.flags.terraformReleasesUrl`. |
| `CustomTofuReleasesUrl` | `${AzBuilderApiUrl}/tofu/index.json` | Sets `io.terrakube.terraform.flags.tofuReleasesUrl`. |

### General Settings Executor

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `EphemeralFlagBatch` | `false` | This will be the new flag used to trigger the ephemeral jobs |
| `EphemeralJobData` |  | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.flags.ephemeralJobData`. |
| `ExecutorFlagDisableAcknowledge` | `false` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.flags.disableAcknowledge`. |
| `ExecutorAsyncStructuredOutput` | `true` | Structured plan/apply output: persist context via a bounded async queue off the terraform process-output reader thread (set false for the previous synchronous behaviour). |
| `ExecutorStructuredOutputRecovery` | `true` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.flags.structuredOutputRecovery`. |
| `ExecutorStructuredOutputQueueCapacity` | `256` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.structured-output.queue-capacity`. |
| `ExecutorStructuredOutputQueueMaxBytes` | `67108864` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.structured-output.queue-max-bytes`. |
| `ExecutorStructuredOutputMaxPersistAttempts` | `4` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.structured-output.max-persist-attempts`. |
| `ExecutorStructuredOutputInitialBackoffMs` | `250` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.structured-output.initial-backoff-ms`. |
| `ExecutorStructuredOutputMaxBackoffMs` | `4000` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.structured-output.max-backoff-ms`. |
| `ExecutorStructuredOutputDrainTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.structured-output.drain-timeout-ms`. |
| `ExecutorStructuredOutputRecoveryRetentionMs` | `600000` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.structured-output.recovery-retention-ms`. |
| `ExecutorStructuredOutputRecoveryInitialDelayMs` | `15000` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.structured-output.recovery-initial-delay-ms`. |
| `ExecutorStructuredOutputRecoveryMaxDelayMs` | `60000` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.structured-output.recovery-max-delay-ms`. |
| `ExecutorStructuredOutputRecoveryMaxRetained` | `64` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.structured-output.recovery-max-retained`. |
| `ExecutorStructuredOutputRecoveryMaxRetainedBytes` | `67108864` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.structured-output.recovery-max-retained-bytes`. |
| `ExecutorContextConnectTimeoutMs` | `5000` | Executor -> API /context/v1 HTTP timeouts (separate from object-storage timeouts). |
| `ExecutorContextReadTimeoutMs` | `15000` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.context.read-timeout-ms`. |
| `ExecutorJobMaxDurationMinutes` | `360` | Ceiling for a single job before the pod is marked unhealthy (watchdog for a wedged terraform/hook process) |

### Save Terraform logs via API

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `LogViaApi` | `false` | Sets `io.executor.log-via-api`. |
| `ExecutorLogsRedisMaxLen` | `200000` | Approximate cap on the per-job live-log Redis stream (~200k lines) so a huge apply can't exhaust ElastiCache. The complete log is always persisted to object storage at step end. |
| `ExecutorLogsEchoToServiceLog` | `false` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.logs.echoToServiceLog`. |
| `ExecutorLogsLiveLineMaxBytes` | `65536` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.logs.liveLineMaxBytes`. |
| `ExecutorLogsApiQueueMaxBytes` | `16777216` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.logs.apiQueueMaxBytes`. |
| `ExecutorLogsApiBatchMaxBytes` | `1048576` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.logs.apiBatchMaxBytes`. |
| `ExecutorLogsStepOutputMemoryBytes` | `4194304` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.logs.stepOutputMemoryBytes`. |
| `ExecutorLogsRenderedPlanContextMaxBytes` | `49152` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.logs.renderedPlanContextMaxBytes`. |
| `ExecutorLogsArchiveEnabled` | `true` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.logs.archiveEnabled`. |
| `ExecutorLogsArchivePartBytes` | `1048576` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.logs.archivePartBytes`. |
| `ExecutorLogsArchiveIntervalSeconds` | `30` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.logs.archiveIntervalSeconds`. |
| `ExecutorLogsArchiveMaxParts` | `1000` | Sets `io.terrakube.executor.logs.archiveMaxParts`. |
